notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 relationship outcome
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes say Celebrate Blackfoot had a local company providing bounce houses for 2026. Gmail confirms Amy emailed Dalicca on April 23, 2026 after Kristy spoke with the Chamber. The City of Blackfoot calendar confirms Celebrate Blackfoot took place June 26-27, 2026. Source: handwritten call notes page 69; Adventure Zone Gmail; City of Blackfoot calendar.
